By the numbers

Worked out from every product Apple Sunset tracks, and recalculated each time the site updates.

33% of the 27 product releases tracked by Apple Sunset have happened in September (9 of 27).

41% of the 27 product releases tracked by Apple Sunset have landed on a Friday (11 of 27).

iPhone products have refreshed roughly every 364 days on average, based on 2 refreshes tracked by Apple Sunset.

Mac products have refreshed roughly every 509 days on average, based on 5 refreshes tracked by Apple Sunset.

Apple Watch products have refreshed roughly every 364 days on average, based on 2 refreshes tracked by Apple Sunset.

AirPods products have refreshed roughly every 1074 days on average, based on 6 refreshes tracked by Apple Sunset.

The MacBook (12-inch) had the longest run of any discontinued product tracked by Apple Sunset, lasting about 4 years before being replaced.

The iPod touch had the shortest run of any discontinued product tracked by Apple Sunset, lasting about 2 years.

Apple Sunset is currently tracking 11 Apple products across 6 categories.
